2: One word opens another room.; Follow the image until it becomes a different image.  Keep the door open long enough for something unexpected to arrive.
3: A mind making images.; Some of these experiments came out of late nights with ketamine, near the edge of a K-hole. I would follow a word with another word, pull in a random reference, and ask Midjourney to show me what I could imagine.  An association became an image. That image became the beginning of something else. I wanted to keep following it, even when I could not explain where it was going.

45: Permission to imagine.; For a long time I carried an idea of what I was supposed to do. Psychedelics helped loosen that grip. Making images gave that freedom a form.  These pages hold a small part of that process: a phrase followed until it turns strange, a reference taken somewhere it has never been, an idea allowed to exist before I know what to call it.  I can follow it. I can make something from it.
